replacements.Por instalación, un hyperscale de 100 MW: Per facility, a 100 MW hyperscale data center consumes substantially more water than a medium-sized golf course. In aggregate, annual irrigation of US golf courses exceeds the global water footprint the IEA currently estimates for data centers.
replacements.A esta escala gana claramente el data ce: At this scale the data center is clearly larger: a typical 100 MW facility is equivalent to about 8.6 medium-sized US golf facilities.
replacements.Aquí gana el golf en agregado: solo la i: At the aggregate level golf is larger: annual irrigation of US golf courses alone is about 3.6 times the IEA's 2024 global estimate for data centers.

replacements.No existe aquí una base robusta para afi: There is no robust basis here for claiming a worldwide water total for golf courses. The strongest available comparison is therefore aggregate US golf versus global IEA data centers. In addition, the golf figure measures applied irrigation water, while the IEA data-center figure also includes indirect uses associated with electricity, chips and the supply chain.
